pr_title: ui: fix combine endpoint when activity table is empty
pr_body:
problem:
The combine endpoint would return an error if the activity table did not have any rows for the specificied time, and had rows for an older time frame. This endpoint returned correctly if the activity tables were completely empty.

Error:
expected one row but got none on getSourceStatsInfo.getRuntime attached stack trace
-- stack trace:
github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/server.getSourceStatsInfo.func1
  github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/server/combined_statement_stats.go:341
github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/server.getSourceStatsInfo
  github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/server/combined_statement_stats.go:397
github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/server.getCombinedStatementStats
  github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/server/combined_statement_stats.go:162
github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/server.(*statusServer).CombinedStatementStats
  github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pkg/server/combined_statement_stats.go:67

Solution:
Return 0 instead of returning an error, and pass in the flag to the method to match the fallback logic.

Fixes: #111320

Release note (ui change): Fixes an error on the activity page when there was a workload and then the workload stopped so no queries ran against the db in the last hour.
